title: Numeric-only abbreviated commit hash
rationale: Tests whether a seven-digit commit hash should be spoken as individual digits instead of a large number.

title: Mixed abbreviated commit hash
rationale: Checks the already-acceptable mixed letter-and-digit pronunciation before applying any broader rule.

title: Large quantity without commas
rationale: Tests the safety boundary: numeric context may mean the value should remain a number even without separators.

title: Large quantity with commas
rationale: Confirms that conventional numeric formatting continues to produce an ordinary quantity.

title: Short numeric reference number
rationale: Tests whether an explicit reference label provides enough context to read a short numeric identifier digit by digit.
originalText: Reference number 8018181 is ready for review.
expectedPreparedText: Reference number 8 0 1 8 1 8 1 is ready for review.

title: Long numeric message identifier
rationale: Tests shortening a strongly labelled, eighteen-digit platform identifier while retaining the original sentence.

title: Standalone twenty-digit string
rationale: Tests the proposed conservative cutoff for an uninterrupted numeric line with no useful spoken structure.

title: Full Git commit hash
rationale: Tests the conventional seven-character short form while retaining the useful surrounding commit context.

title: Session UUID
rationale: Tests a four-character prefix plus etc. without losing what the UUID refers to.
expectedPreparedText: Session 5 5 0 e, etc., failed to start.

title: Long authentication token
rationale: Tests a short prefix plus etc. for a token whose complete literal value provides no useful listening value.
expectedPreparedText: Token: e y J h, etc.
